description.fallback: Joseph launches one of his Ripple clackers at Wamuu, who easily dodges with a slight tilt of his head. Joseph explains that his Ripple is still fairly weak, but, the clacker will enable him to rip through the Pillar Men's protective skin and hurt them. The Pillar Men are amused at the sight of such an unorthodox weapon and wonder if the human race has evolved backwards.
